naming: Name designs <ID>.f3d or <ID>.f3z, the library M02a.tools, posted programs <ID>__<post>.<ext> (lower-case a-z, 0-9, and hyphen post slug; nc, tap, or txt extension), and shared post processors posts/<post>.cps, sent once per zip.
defaults: Leave unnamed values at Fusion defaults. Generate every operation before saving. Each twin starts from its a file and changes only the named setting.

recipes.instructions: The CAM plate and one setup. The plate: a 60 (X) × 40 (Y) rectangle centred on the origin on XY, extruded 15 up; a 30 × 20 pocket centred on the top face, corners R5, 5 deep; and four Ø6 holes through at (±22, ±14). It spans x −30…30, y −20…20, z 0…15. The setup: Milling, the WCS in model orientation with its origin at the top centre of the stock, and a stock box 2 larger on each side and 1 above the part. Reference drawing (PNG) How: Design: Sketch on XY, Center Rectangle from the origin, 60 along X and 40 along Y. Extrude 15 up, New Body. Sketch on the top face: Center Rectangle 30 × 20 from the origin, Sketch Fillet R5 on its four corners; Extrude −5, Cut. Hole tool on the top face, four points at (22, 14), (−22, 14), (−22, −14), and (22, −14), Simple, Ø6, Through All. Manufacture: Setup → New Setup. Setup tab: Operation Type Milling; Work Coordinate System: Orientation Model orientation, Origin Stock box point, and click the point at the top centre of the stock box. Stock tab: Mode Relative size box, Stock Offset Mode Add stock to sides and top-bottom, Stock Side Offset 2, Stock Top Offset 1, Stock Bottom Offset 0. OK, and leave the setup named Setup1.

recipes.instructions: A tool library of three tools, and M01a with one Face operation that uses tool 1. Send the library too, exported as M02a.tools. Tool 1: flat end mill Ø6, 3 flutes. Tool 2: ball end mill Ø6, 2 flutes. Tool 3: drill Ø6, tip angle 118°. How: Manufacture → Manage → Tool Library. Under Local, right-click Library → New library, and name it CAM fixtures. In it, add three tools, units mm, with these Cutter values and the Post Processor Number shown. Tool 1, Flat end mill: Diameter 6, Number of flutes 3, Flute length 15, Shoulder length 20, Overall length 50, Shaft diameter 6, Length below holder 25; Number 1. Tool 2, Ball end mill: Diameter 6, Number of flutes 2, the same lengths; Number 2. Tool 3, Drill: Diameter 6, Tip angle 118°, Flute length 30, Overall length 60, Shaft diameter 6, Length below holder 40; Number 3. Right-click the library, Export, and save it as M02a.tools. Then open M01a, save it as M02a, and add 2D → Face: Tool 1, Spindle Speed 10000 rpm, Cutting Feedrate 1000 mm/min; Passes: Stepover 4.5; everything else as it comes.

recipes.instructions: The CAM dome, a setup like M01's, and a 3D Adaptive Clearing with tool 1. The dome: a 60 (X) × 40 (Y) rectangle centred on the origin on XY, extruded 20 up, with R10 fillets on its four top edges. It spans x −30…30, y −20…20, z 0…20. Reference drawing (PNG) How: New design. Sketch on XY, Center Rectangle from the origin, 60 along X and 40 along Y. Extrude 20 up, New Body. Fillet the four top edges in one Fillet, R10. Manufacture: a setup exactly as in M01 (Milling; Model orientation; origin at the stock box's top centre; Relative size box, side offset 2, top offset 1, bottom offset 0). Then 3D → Adaptive Clearing. Tool: tool 1 from CAM fixtures, Spindle Speed 10000 rpm, Cutting Feedrate 1000 mm/min. Passes: Optimal Load 1, Maximum Stepdown 2; Stock to Leave ticked, Radial Stock to Leave 0.5, Axial Stock to Leave 0.5.

Setup tab: Operation Type Milling; Work Coordinate System: Orientation Select Z axis/plane & X axis, pick the plate's bottom face for Z and tick Flip Z Axis so Z points down, out of the bottom; Origin Stock box point, the point at the centre of the stock's bottom face. recipes.instructions: M05a with a post processor chosen in the setup, and its NC program. Send the NC file too if Fusion lets you post (M11a__fanuc.nc); it's welcome but optional. How: Open M05a, save it as M11a. Edit Setup1, Post Process tab: Program Name/Number 1001, Program Comment M11. Then right-click Setup1 → Create NC Program: Post Fanuc / fanuc from the Fusion library, Program name 1001, Program comment M11, Units Millimeters, Output folder anywhere. OK, so an NC Program appears in the browser and is saved with the design. Right-click it → Post Process to write M11a__fanuc.nc (some free plans can't post; then send just the design).
